goal: Inspect this glass bottle for defects. Single static image from a fixed camera: no other viewpoints or lighting exist.

findings.description: Top-down view of the bottle mouth showing concentric rings. The inner bore is dark, and a textured, mottled grey-green ring surrounds it. This ring has a rough, pebbly look around most of its circumference.
hypotheses: normal molded glass texture on the inner finish or neck
light scattering from the curved glass

findings.description: Top-down view of the bottle mouth showing concentric rings, a dark central bore, a textured grey-green inner rim band, and an amber/orange reflective ring around the lip. The second image looks much like the reference. The orange reflections are broken in places and there is a small bright glint at the lower left near about 8 o'clock, and a short dark mark at the upper right near 1-2 o'clock on the orange ring. The reference shows similar glints and breaks, though not at identical positions.
hypotheses: normal glass-finish reflections and mold seam features
slight rotation or positional difference of the bottle relative to the reference
minor lip chip or scratch (cannot be confirmed from appearance)
